name: Barbell Close-Grip Overhead Press
steps: Stand tall with a barbell resting across your front shoulders, hands slightly inside shoulder width, and elbows pointing straight ahead.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly to keep your torso stacked.
Tuck your chin slightly back and press the bar straight overhead until your arms extend fully.
Lower the bar smoothly down in front of your face back to your front shoulders.
tips: Keep your forearms vertical directly beneath the bar as it leaves your shoulders.
Avoid arching your lower back to push the bar past sticky points.
